svg.text: PostgreSQL dragonfury_local · 92 tables · 1154 columns · 66 enforced foreign keys · 57 unenforced (logical) links

Each card shows primary key, foreign keys and logical links; "+N more columns" are not listed. A store is not a table: it is a store_admin user with a store_code (stored as plain text on many tables).
Enforced foreign key (circle = many side, arrow = referenced table)
Logical link: column like user_id / game_id that points to a table but has no database constraint (marked ~ on the card)
